title: 💻 Mission 1 — Agent ID Generator
subtitle: Create a formatted Morpheus agent identification code.
instructions: Replace each "____" with the correct variable (name, team, or agent_number).
starterCode:
# AGENT ID GENERATOR - Morpheus Security Systems

# Step 1: Collect user input
name = input("Enter your first name: ")
team = input("Enter your team: ")
agent_number = input("Enter a 3-digit number: ")

# Step 2: Build the Agent ID
# Replace each "____" with the correct variable (name, team, or agent_number)
agent_id = "____" + "-" + "____" + "-" + "____"

# Step 3: Display the result
print("=== MORPHEUS SECURITY SYSTEMS ===")
print("Agent ID:", "____")
print("Status: ACTIVE")
hints: The required order for the Agent ID is name, team, then agent_number.
Remove the quotes around each blank — you want the variable's value, not the literal text "____".
The last blank in Step 3 should be the agent_id variable you built in Step 2.

codeChecks.message: In Step 2, replace every "____" with a variable.
In Step 3, print the agent_id variable.

successMessage: Your code includes the required variables. Run it and check that your Agent ID and status print correctly.
